classification_provenance.crosswalk_kind: Derived join of primary lists, not an official published concordance.
classification_provenance.external_parent_limit: Current child units must aggregate to the historical parent; historical counts cannot be allocated to children.
classification_provenance.scope_limit: Destination response classes and RM code identity only; full-matrix cohort equivalence and benchmark approval are not established.
classification_provenance.source_method: Official COMTRAES by LUGTRAES aggregate for the same habitual-RM-home/employed cohort; not numeric prefix inference.

cohort_caveats: 2002 cannot separate home workers from other same-commune workers. The diagonal is excluded in both years; full-matrix cohort equivalence is not established.
Absent 2024 pairs are assigned zero only under the existing complete known-workplace count-aggregation assumption; they are not missing survey observations.
The 52 RM codes are stable in the audited primary lists; this does not establish cadastral boundary equivalence.
Crosswalk is derived from primary lists, not an official published concordance. Four external historical parents require child aggregation and cannot be allocated to child units.
Foreign categories are classified from responses, not numeric prefixes; country names remain unmapped. All raw categories remain unchanged in raw_od.csv.
Counts represent employed people at usual workplaces, not daily trips. INE assumes employed students reported work in 2002.
Domestic external, foreign, unknown and diagonal workers are excluded, not redistributed. No global normalization is applied.
declared_input_provenance.retrieval_time_note: Exact source retrieval UTC was not recorded.

source_frames.2002: All enumeration geography; habitual RM home VIVEHAB; employed SLABORAL 1/2/4; raw COMTRAES classified by official workplace-answer aggregate.
source_frames.2024: Canonical RM-resident work_od.csv; work-location codes 2/3 and known domestic destinations; home workers, multiple/foreign/unknown destinations already excluded upstream.

limitations: Observed target margins are supplied conditions, not predicted outcomes.
P ignores destination margins; C is the first IPF sweep, not a distinct allocation law. IPF fits extra column constraints.
All 2652 off-diagonal cells remain in the domain; no new support, target renormalization or support repair.
2002 home workers cannot be separated within the excluded diagonal; 2024 excludes work-at-home. Full-matrix cohort equivalence is not established.
Unequal nonresponse, employed-student assumptions and multiple/no-fixed workplaces remain comparability limits.
Repeated population snapshots do not identify relocation or a housing/job policy response.
provenance_warning: Manifest hashes are declared, not runtime verified. Record actual input, code and output hashes separately.
scope: Retrospective allocation conditional on observed 2024 margins; no causal, future-margin or actual API validation claim
